task_description: Four agents collaborate to research the effects of climate change on Arctic biodiversity by gathering data from multiple online sources, synthesizing the findings, and producing a comprehensive research report. They must ensure accuracy and proper source attribution.
expected_outcome: The agents successfully gather, synthesize, and report accurate and well-attributed information about the effects of climate change on Arctic biodiversity.

agents.description: Collects raw data from multiple designated online sources related to Arctic biodiversity.
Analyzes collected data, identifies trends and patterns, and summarizes findings.
Validates the accuracy of the synthesized data and ensures correct source attribution.
Compiles the final research report using validated data and formats it for presentation.

content.data: Collected raw data from sources A, B, C

content.validated_data: Verified data but missing source attribution

content.request: Need more recent data from source B

content.data: Additional recent data from source B

content.revisions: Revised sections based on additional analysis

content.final_report: Completed research report with all sections
